svg.title: Figure 4 — Bénin AgroMarket: Empirical Candidate Shocks, Synchronized Surges & Outlier Jumps (2019–2026 Tier-1 Markets)
svg.desc: Three-panel timeline showing monthly Tier-1 median MoM % changes, share of markets surging >=+35% MoM, and count of >=2x outlier jumps for Maize (white), Tomatoes, and Yam (white) on 2019-2026 Tier-1 markets.
svg.text: Figure 4 — Changements brusques, chocs candidats synchronisés et sauts atypiques (2019–2026, Marchés Tier-1)
Détection purement empirique sur la fenêtre 2019–2026 (barres = % de marchés Tier-1 avec saut mensuel >= +35% ou <= -30% ; courbe = variation mensuelle médiane %)
4A. Maïs blanc — Maize (white) [2019–2026 Tier-1 (49 Markets, 4162 Obs): 11 Jump Outliers |ΔlnP|>ln2, 31 Level Outliers |z|>3.5]
4B. Tomate fraîche — Tomatoes [2019–2026 Tier-1 (43 Markets, 3664 Obs): 237 Jump Outliers |ΔlnP|>ln2, 40 Level Outliers |z|>3.5]
4C. Igname blanche — Yam (white) [2019–2026 Tier-1 (19 Markets, 1603 Obs): 17 Jump Outliers |ΔlnP|>ln2, 68 Level Outliers |z|>3.5]

Source: src/analysis/eda.py → docs/tables/eda_abrupt_changes.md (2019–2026 Tier-1 markets). Upward red bars = % of Tier-1 markets jumping >=+35% MoM; downward blue bars = % dropping <=-30% MoM; solid curve = Tier-1 median MoM %.
